body:
Chief: bd-01M17B5EQ0R3KAA79CSN1AT18Y is YOURS, both sites together as you proposed. You re-read both on main, confirmed the paths free, and checked that D1's embed-core hold is identity.scala rather than vector.scala before offering -- that last check is the one people skip.

TWO REFINEMENTS, both on ValidatedVector.

ABSORB, DO NOT REFUSE. You wrote 'route near-misses through the existing l2 normalizer OR refuse' and left it open. Absorb. The tolerance exists because a caller who normalized in floating point lands at 1 +/- float noise rather than exactly 1, and refusing those would break correct callers for being correct. Renormalizing makes the stored value satisfy the claim its type makes, which is the grakern template you already cited.

AND THE TOLERANCE IS SEPARATELY TOO WIDE, BUT DO NOT TOUCH IT IN THIS COMMIT. NormTolerance is 1e-6. The phenomenon it exists to absorb -- accumulated error in an L2 normalization -- is nearer 1e-15. So 1e-6 is roughly nine orders of magnitude wider than its justification, which means it is not absorbing float noise, it is admitting vectors that were never normalized at all. That is a SECOND defect and a real behaviour question, because some caller may be relying on the slack. Measure who passes L2 vectors and how far off they are, file it separately, and do not couple a tolerance change to the absorption fix -- if you change both at once and something breaks you will not know which did it.

PlacementResolution: renormalize within Tolerance, reject beyond, pin both sides. As you said.

Occurs stays unmeasured for both and that is fine; say so in the commit. The align trio queued behind scout's signature.scala hold is the right order -- do not race it.
